thread:
jamie: Kicking off a small tilt for router: shifting 18% -> green pool. Change window 00:30-01:00 UTC. Pinning v2.3.1-green for the tilt. Will monitor 5m moving p50/p95 and error rate.

alex: Copy. Which LB rule are we touching?

jamie: router-edge-weight-rule-18. I'll run the gradual tilt and then warm caches.

priya: Health checks to watch: router_backend_5xx, request_latency_p95, kvcache_hit_ratio. If any 5xx > 0.5% or p95 increases > 40% vs baseline -> pause/rollback.

mike: Pre-warming step queued. Running smoke against green before tilt:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --target green --concurrency 50 --duration 60
```
If smoke fails, we abort.

jamie: deploy-bot NOTE: canary gating enabled, automatic rollback threshold set to 0.5% 5xx.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Starting traffic tilt: 0% -> 6% -> 12% -> 18% (30s steady between increments). Rollback hook configured. Details: /deploys/tilt/2134568901

router-bot: Routing change applied to edge-zone-1. New weights propagated.

tayla: Quick check — pinned config: `service.router.version = v2.3.1-green`, `session_affinity = none`, `max_conn = 300`. Confirm?

jamie: Confirmed. session_affinity unchanged. max_conn = 300.

oncall-sre: Watching metrics. I'll alert if p95 > 25% above baseline or error budget burn.

(tilt progress)
jamie: 6% -> stable 30s
jamie: 12% -> stable 30s
jamie: 18% -> stable 30s

mike: Smoke run results: 0 failures, p95 ~ baseline, kvcache hit 86% :thumbsup:

priya: Seeing a small spike in CPU on green pods, but within reserve. No errors.

oncall-sre: Alert triggered: slight latency bump in eu-west but within SLOs, no 5xx. Monitoring.

jamie: Okay leaving tilt at 18% for warm window 20m. Plan: if all good after warm window, shift to 60% then cutover during next change window.

(10m later)

oncall-sre: Noting an increase in tail latency for a subset of green replicas. Investigating traces.

alex: Can we pin traffic away from problematic replica set? Router can set per-pool weights. Suggest reduce weight on green-pool-b by 50%.

jamie: Executing targeted weight adjustment.

jamie: Ran command:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/route/weights 
 -d '{"pool":"green-pool-b","weight_delta":-50}' \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN'
```

router-bot: Applied weight delta to green-pool-b. Effective green share now distributed across remaining green replicas.

priya: Traces show a misbehaving replica; raising issue to infra to cordon and redeploy that node.

oncall-sre: No new 5xx after adjustment. p95 back to acceptable.

jamie: Since impact contained and automated rollback not triggered, we will keep tilt and continue warm. I'll open a follow-up RFC to pin evicted replicas out of rotation until redeploy.

mike: Filing ticket INFRA-4412 to cordon/redeploy.

deploy-bot: Tilt run complete. Final state: 18% green, pinned version v2.3.1-green. Rollback not executed. Logs: /deploys/tilt/2134568901/logs

tayla: Postmortem note: consider adding per-replica health-weighting to router to avoid manual deltas.

jamie: Agreed — action items:
- INFRA-4412: cordon/redeploy bad replica (mike)
- TASK: add per-replica health-based weight (priya)
- TASK: document tilt playbook with exact curl snippets (jamie)

alex: :thumbsup: Great run. Leaving this thread open for any late regressions.

oncall-sre: No further alerts. Closing watch in 30m unless something pops.

jamie: Thanks everyone. Final note: if we need to rollback later, command is:
```
# rollback to blue pinned v2.3.0
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/route/pin 
 -d '{"service":"router","version":"v2.3.0-blue"}' \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN'
```

:green_heart:
